name: alarm-non-reading-representative
source: representative — hand-authored for PLAN-0107 AC-9, same class as traces 02/03 (no live capture). The first trace whose event is NOT event_type 'reading': an alarm carries a description and NO measured_value, so it scores composition for an event lacking the numeric field every prior trace supplies. Modelled on the alarm the energy adapter already emits (verticals/energy/data_adapter/synthetic.py:255-262). See the AC-9 ruling annotation in docs/plans/0107-oracle-coverage-hardening.md: the anchor filter's own event_type clause is undiscriminating on current data, so this trace covers the composition path for non-reading events and does not claim to pin that clause.
